luts.title: Ionias
luts.overview: Ionias delivers soft contrast, rich blues and warm natural skin tones inspired by the Mediterranean coastline. Designed for everyday photography, it creates a clean cinematic look straight out of camera while preserving realistic colour and excellent flexibility.

luts.title: Loen
luts.overview: With rich analog colors and deep contrast, this LUT was developed with spectral analysis to simulate professional grade negative film, printed on high quality photographic paper.

luts.title: City Film
luts.overview: This LUT was inspired by film, I have tried to replicate a warmer tone and optimised it to favour the red and orange colours of building roofs and the gentle cyan colour of the sky.

luts.title: Maku
luts.overview: Out of my two portrait-focused LUTs Maku and Mara, this is the slightly punchier of the two with stronger saturation and contrast, but with maybe a more true to life colour palette overall. I’ve designed these twin LUTs to be almost like the same film stock that’s been scanned by two different scanners - one of the biggest noticeable differences though can be found in the blue tones, which lean brighter and more teal with Maku.

luts.title: Mara
luts.overview: Out of my two portrait-focused LUTs Maku and Mara, this is the slightly more subtle, with softer saturation and contrast. I’ve designed these twin LUTs to be almost like the same film stock that’s been scanned by two different scanners - one of the biggest noticeable differences though can be found in the green tones, which are darker and bluer with Mara.

luts.title: Orlock
luts.overview: This monochrome LUT fades the blacks and whites both to a softer grey and then does something special to the contrast of the mid tones. When using this LUT for yourself, you can 100% play around with the base Photo Style to get a different result every time. For a harder tonal structure use this LUT with the Photo Style LEICA Monochrome, for a softer contrast use the standard Monochrome Photo Style, or keep it at (my favourite) L.Monochrome D for a more film-like result with deep rich shadows.

luts.title: Natural+
luts.overview: The Natural+ LUT is perfect for attaining excellent straight out camera colours that really pop.  Based on the Natural profile, Natural+ LUT offers saturated mid-tones with a modified hue giving you excellent skin tones, deep blue skies, and a “finished look" without corrections in post production.  This LUT is perfect for any outdoor scenes on a bright and sunny day or for a finished look out of camera for YouTube videos in the studio.

luts.title: Fresh Bright
luts.overview: This Japanese-inspired bright and fresh LUT is specifically designed to create vibrant, light-hearted portraits. By brightening shadows, reducing contrast, and enhancing colour depth, it produces a clean, transparent visual quality. Whether capturing sunny outdoor scenes or well-lit interiors, it effortlessly infuses your work with a refreshing vitality and gentle atmosphere, effortlessly conveying a lively and soothing Japanese lifestyle aesthetic.

luts.title: Color Harmony
luts.overview: Based on the STD ，this Japanese-inspired, subtly cool-toned colour grading LUT prioritises skin tone optimisation. Featuring understated stylised shadows, it suits most everyday shooting scenarios with strong versatility, performing well even in overcast conditions. Its user-friendly approach makes it accessible to LUT users and ideal for beginners.

luts.title: RaG Film
luts.overview: Based on Cinema Dynamic Range 2 mode colour grading, based on cinematic principles, is suitable for both photography and videography. Building upon the original mode, it enhances contrast while utilising the mode's dynamic range to ensure shadows remain relatively transparent. The LUT exhibits slightly heightened overall contrast with a clear, crisp aesthetic and subtle filmic character. It emphasises reds and greens while optimising skin tones, making it ideal for summer street photography, floral shots, and portraiture.

luts.title: warm skin
luts.overview: Colour grading based on the STD standard profile, primarily optimised for skin tones, renders a warm white output. This profile can be applied directly or used as a secondary LUT for skin tone adjustment. It proves particularly effective at restoring facial colour in overcast conditions where skin tones may appear washed out. Moderate increases in exposure and saturation have been applied; when used as a secondary LUT, its intensity can be adjusted according to the shooting environment.

luts.title: Eternal
luts.overview: Simultaneously, skin tones have been optimised. The overall tone of the LUT remains quite saturated and light-demanding. When shooting portraits, ensure a light source is present. If no direct light is available, adjust in-camera exposure compensation to +1/3 to +2/3 and shadows to +1 to +2. For street photography, it is recommended to enable grain at the LOW setting.

luts.title: Patina of Rain
Sunny Mint
luts.overview: This LUT specifically designed for portraits and green plant scenes, draws inspiration from the classic color science of Panasonic cameras. It employs a slightly cool green-tinged, low-contrast palette, carefully preserved pink and healthy skin tones, and desaturated emerald greens to effortlessly create transparent, clean, and breathable Japanese-style imagery with a fresh aesthetic. It is ideal for outdoor portraits, lifestyle documentation, and product photography. For optimal results, it is recommended to use in soft lighting conditions with slight overexposure.

luts.title: Light Green
luts.overview: This LUT centres on a cinematic green palette, delivering sophisticated green tones while precisely preserving the translucent quality of skin tones. Suitable for all shooting scenarios including portraits, location scouting, and still life, it is specially optimised for LUMIX cameras. We recommend using it with slight overexposure in ample lighting to effortlessly create breathable, film-grade visuals.

luts.title: Vintage Summer
luts.overview: This preset is a stylised film simulation based on Panasonic's Std colour standard. It adopts the tonal characteristics of green-leaning film stock as its foundational aesthetic, emphasising the rendering of blue and green hues while also delivering vivid representations of reds and oranges. Upon this foundation, it prioritises soft, natural skin tones for portraiture.

luts.title: Mosslight
luts.overview:
This preset is a stylised film simulation crafted based on the Panasonic Std standard colour profile. It takes the tonal characteristics of portrait film as its foundational style, with a subtle addition of warm colour bias. It performs optimally in well-lit conditions, offering moderate contrast and delivering a bright, crisp texture. In low-light scenarios, it prioritises skin tones while increasing contrast, with shadows exhibiting a slight yellow-green cast.
Developed through sampling results across diverse lighting and colour environments, it incorporates refinements inspired by authentic portrait film behaviour. This versatility makes it well-suited for portraits, landscapes, street photography, and still life.

luts.title: Firebird
luts.overview:
Inspired by an experimental colour negative film, my "Firebird" LUT delivers a pretty wild look to your images.
Expect buckets of contrast, intense fiery reds and greens that explode. I recommend pairing this this LUT with some film grain to complete that nostalgic 35mm look.
You can try "Firebird" at 100% or experiment by turning down your LUT Opacity. It’s a fun one to play with so load it up, go nuts and set your images alight…

Inspired by a colour negative film praised for its retro charm, my "1992" LUT will cool down any scene and provide your images with a sense of nostalgia.
This LUT gives an overall cool look with a particular focus on blues and magentas. Yellows get muted, greens go dark, but like the film stock this LUT was based on, the reds still have a nice pop.
You can try "1992" at 100% or experiment by turning down your LUT Opacity. It’s a cool LUT to play with and goes nicely with some film grain, so get it loaded and give your images that unique 90s character…

luts.title: Yogi
luts.overview: "Yogi" creates beautiful bright warm tones that make your colours pop. Perfect for Summer days as well as helping achieve a more celluloid style. I think it looks great when under exposed slightly, give it a try in harsh sunlight!

luts.title: ER-ISSA
luts.overview:
Vibrant filmic style with subtle teal and orange effect. Works well in sunny and cloudy situations.
Best used with Daylight WB but feel free to experiment. For high contrast backlit situations adjust i-Dynamic Range.
Better to be slightly underexposed to keep skies not too saturated.

luts.title: Zell Am See
luts.overview: The LUT is inspired by the look and feel of analog film. It softens harsh digital tones while enhancing natural contrast and colour depth. The result is a nostalgic yet modern cinematic mood bringing warmth, richness, and a filmic character to the footage.

luts.title: Hibiscus
luts.overview: ‘Hibiscus’ was inspired by one of my absolute favourite film stocks. It’s a LUT that leans on the magenta & green side of the colour scale, with a soft and natural contrast. ‘Hibiscus’ is very versatile, performing well for landscapes, portraits and everything in between. I designed it with just a pinch of green in the shadows and I think it looks great overexposed, under exposed, warmed up and cooled down.

luts.title: Earth
luts.overview: When I picture our planet two colours come to mind… green and blue - and those are exactly the colours my LUT ‘Earth’ was designed to make shine. Inspired by a film stock I love, this LUT is the boldest, punchiest and most contrasy LUT of my four ‘Head-Stock’ LUTs. It’s absolutely perfect for landscapes but works well in a number of scenarios. If shooting in full sun my ‘Earth’ LUT will sing when exposed correctly, but if shooting in gloomier weather my advice would be to slightly underexpose and push the White Balance to the warmer side.

luts.title: Ash
luts.overview: ‘Ash’ is a gorgeous black and white LUT inspired by a film stock, with what I would call a cult following. I designed ‘Ash’ with a base Photo Style of L.Monochrome D which itself was inspired by film, with deep blacks and vibrant whites and ‘Ash’ only adds to the look. The film stock this LUT was based on is sharp with very fine grain so in my LUMIX camera I have my Sharpness around 0 and my Grain set to LOW.

luts.title: Daisy
luts.overview: ‘Daisy’ is based on the film stock which stands for dynamic, and that’s exactly how I would also describe this LUT. It’s full of character with delicious pastel colours and it’s somehow both warm and cool at the same time. I tinted the highlights to a pale blue, the greens to a minty hue and to emulate the halation I added some red to the shadows. I think this LUT looks good warmed up or cooled down and I get the best results by exposing correctly or even slightly over. I’ve been enjoying shooting with it in every scenario, indoors, outdoors, portraits, at events and on the street.

luts.title: BONBOA
luts.overview: "Bonboa" is a warm, dreamy, peachy LUT and was designed to bring the warmth and gorgeous pastel colours I experienced on a recent trip to Portugal. This LUT was not based on any one film stock but it definitely has that film-like tone. For me this LUT looks the best when exposed correctly or slightly over, but it can also be underexposed for a completely different feel. To squeeze the most from "Bonboa" make sure to warm up your White Balance and play with the Contrast. Obrigado…

luts.title: YAMICO
luts.overview:
This LUT is based on the "Standard" photo style, and emphasizes the dark impression with light blue as the main focus, while keeping the white skin tones and the natural color of the lips.
It has a taste that matches well with gothic subculture, and is perfect for street snaps and fashion photography that focuses on people.

luts.title: Dramatic BlackWalker-S
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "Standard" and allows you to easily enjoy the "black and orange" look used in street snaps, etc. It is perfect for cityscapes at night or portraits during the day with flash.

luts.title: Memento Mori warmtone
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "Standard," which has a warm feel like shooting with negative film. You can add grain and use the i-Dynamic Range to expand the ways you can enjoy it. It is perfect for film-like portrait photography and everyday snapshots.

luts.title: Memento Mori cooltone
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "Standard," which has a transparent feel like shooting with negative film. You can add grain or use the i-Dynamic Range to expand the ways you can enjoy it. It is perfect for film-like portrait photography and everyday snapshots.

luts.title: Ontario
luts.overview: "Ontario" was created with a very popular film stock in mind. It has an air of teal and orange about it but still keeps an incredible colour balance and saturation throughout. This LUT works the best in bright sun and it's great for landscapes, portraits and everything in between. I like to add grain when shooting with this LUT (and every LUT) to increase the film-like feeling.

luts.title: Neagh
luts.overview: When designing this look, my aim was to highlight the natural colours of the country I love so much... Ireland! "Neagh" is more restrained than the other Lake LUTs, with  more subtle colours, less saturation but a great overall tone with a minty-green push in the mids and highlights.

luts.title: Kitaura
luts.overview: With"Kitaura" my aim was to design a LUT that replicates the feeling of film photography from Japan. With its deep emerald green shadows and magenta highlights, I think it really captures the tone of classic film. This LUT comes alive during sunrise or sunset and creates a whole other mood entirely from my other Lake LUTs.

luts.title: Winter-V
luts.overview: The 'Winter' LUT is a rad B&W look that is perfect for capturing any scenario. When designing this LUT I raised the black point and lowered the white to give it a slight filmic look, perfect for pairing with some film grain either in-camera or in post. Underexpose this LUT for a darker, moodier B&W look or over expose for a softer look. When shooting with this LUT with my LUMIX cameras I have been setting the base Photo Style to Leica Monochrome to take advantage of this incredible look. Depending on the scene, it can also look great with other Monochrome picture profiles or photo styles. Have a play about for yourself.

luts.title: Autumn-V
luts.overview: My 'Autumn' LUT produces images that look like how Autumn feels, you know the time of year where everything turns a certain shade of rust. With this LUT there is a slight green tint in the highlights but in the shadows it's pure brown. I have also made the greens more emerald in colour in this LUT which reminds me of Japan captured on film. Be careful when exposing the 'Autumn' LUT. When over or underexposed it can look muddy but exposed correctly it's gorgeous. I like to use this LUT in-camera above a Landscape Photo Style for good contrast. This LUT also looks great warmed up with a slight White Balance push.

luts.title: Summer-V
luts.overview: My 'Summer' LUT was designed to be a good all-rounder with bold colours and warmth. It packs a punch with loads of contrast and has tones reminiscent of a family holiday in the 90s, which is perfect for capturing the classic feeling of summer! The 'Summer' LUT looks good both under and overexposed and I like to use this LUT incamera above a Standard Photo Style with the White Balance pushed slightly warm.

luts.title: Spring-V
luts.overview: My 'Spring' LUT was designed to capture the feeling of fresh spring morning with cool tones. In the highlights you'll find a lovely pastel blue, the greens are pushed to the yellow side whereas the yellows are thrusted a more fiery orange. In my opinion the 'Spring' LUT looks best when slightly overexposed and I like to use this LUT in-camera above a Natural Photo Style for a flatter look. Also try playing with the White Balance with this LUT. It cools down and heats up nicely just like Spring itself.

luts.title: Fall Vibes
luts.overview: This LUT enhances warm tones like orange and yellow, making it ideal for fall photography. It’s versatile enough to use as a seasonal look or for adding a cozy, inviting feel to your projects.

luts.title: Black & White 5
luts.overview: A classic black-and-white LUT with bold contrast, perfect for creating striking monochrome imagery. It’s one of my favorites for its timeless and dramatic look.

luts.title: Concert Reel
luts.overview: Designed for live music photography and videography, this LUT emphasizes vibrant, crisp colors that bring concert moments to life. The tones make your visuals pop, capturing the energy of the performance.

luts.title: Strike Contrast
luts.overview: This LUT provides a strong emphasis on contrasts, while not over doing it, but retaining the highlights and brings a bold look to your photos.

luts.title: Natural Reel Profile
luts.overview: A go-to LUT for a wide range of scenarios, including travel and food photography. It provides a clean, natural look that works seamlessly across various settings.

luts.title: Food Preset
luts.overview: This food preset LUT enhances colors, making it ideal for photographers capturing a variety of food items.

luts.title: Reel Envision Set 4
luts.overview: Tailored for diverse creative projects, this LUT off ers a balanced aesthetic that adapts to multiple situations. It’s part of a series I rely on for fl exibility and consistency in my work.

luts.title: Reel Envision Set 5
luts.overview: This LUT is crafted for versatility, with nuanced adjustments that suit a variety of projects. It complements Sets 4 and 6, giving you the tools to refine your vision further.

luts.title: Reel Envision Set 6
luts.overview: Completing the series, this LUT shares the adaptability of Sets 4 and 5. It’s designed to handle unique challenges across different projects, focusing on the punchy colors ensuring a cohesive look in any scenario.

luts.title: Concert Lut 2
luts.overview: This LUT is perfect for photographers seeking a distinctive color style. With the right white balance, it creates a look worthy of printing.

luts.title: Summer
luts.overview: My 'Summer' LUT was designed to be a good all-rounder with bold colours and warmth. It packs a punch with loads of contrast and has tones reminiscent of a family holiday in the 90s, which is perfect for capturing the classic feeling of summer! The 'Summer' LUT looks good both under and overexposed and I like to use this LUT incamera above a Standard Photo Style with the White Balance pushed slightly warm.

luts.title: Spring
luts.overview: My 'Spring' LUT was designed to capture the feeling of fresh spring morning with cool tones. In the highlights you'll find a lovely pastel blue, the greens are pushed to the yellow side whereas the yellows are thrusted a more fiery orange. In my opinion the 'Spring' LUT looks best when slightly overexposed and I like to use this LUT in-camera above a Natural Photo Style for a flatter look. Also try playing with the White Balance with this LUT. It cools down and heats up nicely just like Spring itself.

luts.title: Autumn
luts.overview: My 'Autumn' LUT produces images that look like how Autumn feels, you know the time of year where everything turns a certain shade of rust. With this LUT there is a slight green tint in the highlights but in the shadows it's pure brown. I have also made the greens more emerald in colour in this LUT which reminds me of Japan captured on film. Be careful when exposing the 'Autumn' LUT. When over or underexposed it can look muddy but exposed correctly it's gorgeous. I like to use this LUT in-camera above a Landscape Photo Style for good contrast. This LUT also looks great warmed up with a slight White Balance push.

luts.title: Winter
luts.overview: The 'Winter' LUT is a rad B&W look that is perfect for capturing any scenario. When designing this LUT I raised the black point and lowered the white to give it a slight filmic look, perfect for pairing with some film grain either in-camera or in post. Underexpose this LUT for a darker, moodier B&W look or over expose for a softer look. When shooting with this LUT with my LUMIX cameras I have been setting the base Photo Style to Leica Monochrome to take advantage of this incredible look. Depending on the scene, it can also look great with other Monochrome picture profiles or photo styles. Have a play about for yourself.

luts.title: Driftwood
luts.overview: My classic Rec709 sRGB Grade bring excellent reds – not too magenta – perfect greens & blues and secondary colors. Great all-rounder to rival the official Rec709 Gamma 2.4 LUT.

luts.title: CineStock
luts.overview: A flat filmstock classic look for you to experiment with – you can add saturation and exposure contrast to bring out the colors more.

luts.title: DuneII
luts.overview: Sandy Saharan dune colors give off that Dune & Dune 2 filmic look. Sandy skin tones and yellow tinged backgrounds but without destroying the primes!

luts.title: Eternity
luts.overview: A carefully crafted film stock look and film giving slightly muted colors and a matt finish with a singed classic caste. Great to experiment with.

luts.title: Funky
luts.overview: A funky blue filmic look which you can see here livens up a dreary fishing port scene in a short film I shot recently with the LUMIX S5II. Good look for music concerts or live gigs too!

luts.title: GrOr2
luts.overview: Instead of Teal and Orange this is Green & Orange grade to provide a beautiful cinematic grade which works well all round and will give you something unique to think about.

luts.title: GladIIator
luts.overview: We all love Russel Crowe in Ridley Scott’s Gladiator films and here I’ve analysed the grade in Gladiator 2 to bring you a cool Orange & Teal filmic action LUT with fantastic skin tones.

luts.title: Jackal
luts.overview: Inspired by The Day of the Jackal TV series, a beautiful rich colorful look for your images giving nice skin tones and vibrancy.

luts.title: Gothika
luts.overview: Palefaces with the colors toned back, Gothika is ideal for the horror look – pale dark and scary!

luts.title: Sixty Four
luts.overview: A legendary color reversal film emulated. Sampled many times this took an age to get to a look where I was happy. Classic look that has accurate color reproduction and vibrant intensity.

luts.title: LikePhoto
luts.overview: A Standard looking picture profile but recreated under V-Log to offer you extra color grading capabilities and a classic vibrant photographic look.

luts.title: Optimistic
luts.overview: When your feeling down its time to experiment so its time for a little mystic encouragement with this LUT. Dark, silvery and broody.

luts.title: Cinebase01
luts.overview: A cinematic pop look with colorful pop tones and a glossy contrast to add to the vibe. Looks good for internal adverts.

luts.title: Cinebase02
luts.overview: A balanced slightly less contrasty look to Cinebase01, this one pairs well for external shots and is more filmic blue.

luts.title: Die Hard
luts.overview: One of our favourite films every Christmas, the Die Hard films are fab and this famous filmstock emulation will bring the best action feel to skin tones!

luts.title: Die Hard2
luts.overview: Another take on the Die Hard iconic look and feel but a little colder filmic grade to realiize the look of the second instalment in the film series.

Back to the '60s when mods and rockers met on Brighton beach. Now, capture that spirit with my 1969 LUT, inspired by classic filmstock of yore filmed on an old German camera with a thorium-coated lens!

luts.title: Aquatic
luts.overview: Living by the sea in Brighton I’m always mesmerised by the green blue seas of the English Channel. This look is very filmic.

luts.title: Almost Mono
luts.overview: Not quite black and white! But just enough color and mood to give your monochrome image an edge.

luts.title: Arklight
luts.overview: After filming a LUMIX S5II/X video review, around the same time as emulating the look of some classic film stock emulations, I created this green filmic finish to a Smooth 709 grade I used in the review.

luts.title: Angelic
luts.overview: Particularly good for mid-skin-tones like Asian faces, ‘Angelic’ will help uplift your grades into a heavenly look.

luts.title: BlueIce
luts.overview: This cold and low-contrast pastel color grade to your imagery will certainly make some of your ideas stand out.

luts.title: Apocalypse Now17
luts.overview: Inspired by Francis Ford Coppola's Apocalypse Now, this look emulates the film stock used together with the filmstock's recommended Amber gel! It took weeks to get right and I used many film samples in the process.

luts.title: Bollywood
luts.overview: After many visits to India, including filming a Tiger short in Rajasthan, my trip to Mumbai and meeting Bollywood filmmakers inspired this warm, vibrant mood and look.

luts.title: Evening Glow
luts.overview: Capture the magic of a perfect sunset with this LUT. This LUT is designed to enhance the warm orange and pastel hues of golden hour. Perfect for evening scenes and twilight moments, you'll be able to add a breathtaking glow to your photos and videos.

luts.title: Ningaloo
luts.overview: Bring your summer vibes to life with this LUT, designed to enhance ocean blues and for capturing coastal adventures. This LUT adds a stunning, natural pop to your photos and videos, making every sunny day look even more magical.

luts.title: Daydream
luts.overview: Daydream is a video LUT made for capturing moments of daily life. It will give a boost to the image and make the colors pop. This LUT works best in high-contrast scenes.

luts.title: Everything Golden
luts.overview: Everything Golden is a photo preset made for any travel pictures taken during sunrise or sunset. It will enhance the golden glow and the overall warmth of the photo.

luts.title: Sunset Hour
luts.overview: Sunset Hour is a video LUT made for scenes taken during golden hour. It will enhance the golden glow and the cinematic feel of the video. This LUT works best in low-contrast scenes.

luts.title: Film impression
luts.overview: It's a classic and retro color that evokes the tastes of the last century.

luts.title: Nature skin
luts.overview: It is very suitable for daily vlogs and selfie vlogs. Basically, it has a gentle skin tone and always produces natural colors.

luts.title: Warm film
luts.overview: With its strong film flavor, warm colors and strong contrast, it is suitable for documentary footage.

luts.title: Blue night
luts.overview: It has a slight green-orange flavor, which creates a unique feel when shooting night scenes.

luts.title: Blue sky
luts.overview: With a focus on high and low tones with a hint of cyan, you can use it on cloudy days or indoors without worrying about your skin tone.

luts.title: Skin optimization
luts.overview: It maintains Panasonic's excellent color performance and is a great choice for Asian skin tones. It can also be used as a secondary Lut to change just the skin tone.

luts.title: TXD Grainy Film LUT
luts.overview: Based on the L Classic Neo, it has relatively strong contrast and a distinctive film texture. It is suitable for most indoor and outdoor scenes, and the skin tones were adjusted repeatedly. When taking portrait photos, apply 1 to 2 stops of exposure compensation appropriately to maintain the transparency of skin tones in dark areas. At the same time, adjust the exposure compensation and white balance according to the subject and shooting environment.

luts.title: Summer Freshness
luts.overview: This LUT has an overall bright style, a film-like texture, and pleasant colors that create a summery feel. This LUT is very versatile and can be used for shooting indoors or outdoors, sunny or rainy, portraits or still lifes. When using it, it is also a good idea to overlay Sample LUT2 to adjust the color brightness. For normal shooting, set the color temperature to around 7000K and expose a little brighter.

luts.title: DPJ-GH7-GYM
luts.overview: A vintage-inspired look, with brownish undertones reminiscent of popular film stocks to bring a nostalgic aesthetic to your project. The attenuated highlight intensity and their smooth rolloff prevent the harsh overexposed look and smoothens any specular highlights, while the subtle lift in the shadows creates a medium contrast and balanced look. For best results, your subject’s exposure should be within the range of 20 IRE.

luts.title: BLOCKTRA
luts.overview: This LUT was created to emulate the hollywood “blockbuster” look. Strong contrast, warm oranges, and overall turquoise hue. Excellent for mixed lightning and video applications, but can be used for photos. This LUT is meant to be used with warmer white balance settings.

luts.title: Rustic Sapphire
luts.overview: A more subtle take on the classic orange and teal look. Natural skin tones, deeper blacks, poppy highlights, rusty greens, and a light hue of teal. Great for landscapes, street photography, and shots taken during daylight, but can be used at night.

luts.title: Undyed Shine
luts.overview: This vintage black and white LUT has creamy whites, deeper blacks, and subtle “shine” in the midtones. Can be used for any occasion day or night. Although I like using it most when there’s a subject to photograph.

luts.title: Filmmic
luts.overview: Filmmic LUT emulates the old-school disposable film look by providing green and yellow tints to the image. It adds a slight overall vintage style to the image, to mimic taking photos on old cameras while providing a sharp overall image.

luts.title: T&O
luts.overview: This LUT provides a nice contrast to the image while providing a very subtle Teal & Orange look to the overall image.

luts.title: Classic Teal N Orange
luts.overview: This LUT is designed to give that Classic "Teal & Orange" look while applying directly onto VLOG. It gives warm characteristics and brightens the overall image just a tad.

luts.title: Himalayas-N
luts.overview: Experience the dreamy tones of the Himalayas with our Himalayas LUT. This LUT captures the essence of the majestic mountains, featuring yellowish greens and warm highlights. Perfect for bringing a serene and ethereal look to your footage.

luts.title: Himalayas-V
luts.overview: Experience the dreamy tones of the Himalayas with our Himalayas LUT. This LUT captures the essence of the majestic mountains, featuring yellowish greens and warm highlights. Perfect for bringing a serene and ethereal look to your footage.

luts.title: Classic Black and White
luts.overview: Classic Black and White works best with Natural base. It works best with portraits and provides a perfect black and white classic look with subtle contrast between whites and blacks.

luts.title: Deep Gold
luts.overview: The Deep Gold Video LUT works best on Natural Profile videos. It adds beautiful high contrast golden cast to your summer videos. The golden hues after using this LUT is beautiful and punchy.

luts.title: Moody Blues
luts.overview: Moody Blues works best with Natural Color Profile. Its best used with photos and videos shot in cool cloudy weather when the sky is overcast. This LUT adds some contrasty blues adding those cold blue moody vibes to otherwise flat looking boring footage.

luts.title: Summer Gold
luts.overview: Summer Gold works best with Natural Color Profile. The LUT adds natural, summer golden hues, enhancing the orange tones. It works best with photo/videos shot in summer light. The blacks in this are subtle and faded.

luts.title: Sunset Pile et Face
luts.overview: The "Sunset" LUT aims to warm up the stage and create a warmer mood.

luts.title: Golden hours
luts.overview: This LUT offers a natural, slightly contrasting rendering, while highlighting the orange and blue tones.

luts.title: Urban & Street
luts.overview:
This preset will give your images an urban yet vintage look. The slightly desaturated colors and pronounced grain give the texture and finish that many photographers are looking for.
It will work equally well for portraits, landscapes and street photography.

luts.title: Moody Warm
luts.overview:
This LUT will add character to your images with a single click. The sky will take on a more turquoise color, while the rest of the image will have warmer tones.
This teal & orange mix will give your videos a film-like look, with those tones so sought-after by videographers and filmmakers alike.
The LUT has been designed to apply to both outdoor and indoor shots. Feel free to adjust the intensity of the LUT to perfectly match your images.

luts.title: Gold UltraMax
luts.overview: The "Gold UltraMax" video LUT is a creative way of transforming your V-Log shot into a higher-contrast rendering with a golden cast. It is designed for use with a white balance set at 5600K.

luts.title: Deep Blue
luts.overview: The "Deep Blue" photo LUT is designed for the Natural profile with a white balance between 5600K and 6500K. If required, saturation can be increased to +2. The rendering is creative with a bluish cast.

luts.title: Reglisse
luts.overview: This Lut takes us back in time with its vintage look. It subtly warms up dark and medium tones. It slightly softens the original contrast.

luts.title: Platinum Steel
luts.overview: Platinum steel gives a dark and interesting feel by focusing on the skin tones, and desaturating the yellows and blues. It works exceptionally well for urban style shoots to create a unique look.

luts.title: Black Frost-N
luts.overview: Black Frost is a Photo LUT, and works best with a Natural base photo profile (as opposed to V-Log). It's perfect for a punchy, classic black and white look with quite faded blacks. This photo LUT is ideal for photo walks, portraiture, and night photography.

luts.title: Black Frost-C
luts.overview: Black Frost is a Photo LUT, and works best with a Cine-D base photo profile (as opposed to V-Log). It's perfect for a punchy, classic black and white look with quite faded blacks. This photo LUT is ideal for photo walks, portraiture, and night photography.

luts.title: Streetwise-N
luts.overview: Streetwise is a photo LUT, and works best with a Natural base photo profile. It's great for street photography, architecture, and enhancing warmer orange tones.

luts.title: Streetwise-C
luts.overview: Streetwise is a photo LUT, and works best with a Cine-D base photo profile. It's great for street photography, architecture, and enhancing warmer orange tones.

luts.title: Vintage Vibes
luts.overview: Designed to emulate a by-gone era of warm tones, lifted contrast and an overall fun and bright aesthetic. This LUT was inspired by the old film stocks of the 1960s and 70s that featured such characteristics.

luts.title: Day for Night
luts.overview: This utility LUT transform your daytime shot footage into a night tonality using crushed shadows and highlights and a deep blue hue to simulate the nighttime aura. If the source footage is properly shot you should be able to create a convincing image without having to shoot past sunset.

luts.title: Gritty Cinema
luts.overview: Jon Simo’s most used LUT, this gritty tonality grade deeply crushes the image while retaining a saturated and punchy look, it works great on action scenes, automotive content, and just about anything that needs a hit of intensity.

luts.title: Chasm Lake
luts.overview: This was inspired by my hike to Chasm Lake, where the view from the top features heavy bluish-emerald waters and red-orange rocks. It's designed to enhance blues and greens in a scene, bringing out vibrant colors throughout the image.

luts.title: Dark Floral
luts.overview: This look is ideal when you want to add some darkness to an otherwise bright scene. Dark undertones and intense shadows create a dramatic effect, even in brighter conditions.

luts.title: Dusty Earth
luts.overview: The look I aimed for with this one is to transform the yellows and oranges in a scene, giving them a clay-like texture. It definitely leans towards a vintage feel.

luts.title: Leafy Greens
luts.overview: As the name suggests, I designed this kit to truly make greens stand out. At full strength, it can even go as far as to add a green tint to the very air itself.

luts.title: Lock Box
luts.overview: This LUT is crafted to add a haunting, almost fairy-tale-like color to any scene. After basic correction in V-Log or starting with a picture profile, you can easily dial in the intensity you desire for the effect.

luts.title: Faded Summer
luts.overview: Faded Summer Creative LUT is a tribute to memories and good times of summer days outside. It’s warm, earthy and the lifted shadows give it a semi-vintage flavor.

luts.title: Sunny Beach
luts.overview: Mainly used for wedding photos and travel portraits by the seaside. This preset makes the seaside pictures more film-like with a good contrast between warm and cool colors. Recommend to shoot under the warm light of the setting sun for greater contrast.

luts.title: Style For Camping
luts.overview: This preset is well-suited for shooting outdoor camping scenes,with an overall film-like atmosphere. Apply this preset to outdoor camping and VLOG shooting to preserve colors without obvious traces of color mixing.

luts.title: Refreshing Cuisine
luts.overview: This preset is well-suited for shooting pictures of food, giving an overall fresh and natural tone, retaining the colors of the food while giving it a stylized film vibe.

luts.title: Warm-Contrast Color Mixing
luts.overview: When shooting outdoors in sunlight, we often encounter problems with light and shadow transparency. This LUT was created to unify the light ratio and the different color temperatures of sunlight while outdoors at different times of the day.

luts.title: Cold-Contrast Color Mixing
luts.overview: When shooting outdoors in sunlight, we often encounter problems with light and shadow transparency. This LUT was created to unify the light ratio and the different color temperatures of sunlight while outdoors at different times of the day.

luts.title: Warm-Greenish-orange Hue
luts.overview: For many indoor light sources, I personally prefer greater contrast between cool and warm tones. However, in many cases, the lighting technicians I work with and the needs of the scene will often create different effects for cool and warm tones to facilitate visibility on the on-site monitor.

luts.title: Cold-Greenish-orange Hue
luts.overview: For many indoor light sources, I personally prefer greater contrast between cool and warm tones. However, in many cases, the lighting technicians I work with and the needs of the scene will often create different effects for cool and warm tones to facilitate visibility on the on-site monitor.

luts.title: Warm-Contrast Style
luts.overview: Mostly used for shooting night scenes. It is moderately lightened based on the film-like secondary color palette, so that your content shot under different lights have a moderate warmth and color bias.

luts.title: Cool-Contrast Style
luts.overview: Mostly used for shooting night scenes. It is moderately lightened based on the film-like secondary color palette, so that your content shot under different lights have a moderate cool and color bias.

luts.title: Positive Color
luts.overview: Based upon the colors of classic film, the vivid red, blue and yellow tones pop right out. This is a LUT that can be used in all environments.

luts.title: Tibet Warm Light
luts.overview: The color ratio is designed for environments with strong sunlight. It is overall warmer with lower contrast, giving off a warm and soft visual experience. Can be used both indoors and outdoors.

luts.title: Vintage Film Style
luts.overview: Color matching design based on old school film from the 60s. Gives an overall warm tone. A strong sense of nostalgia.

luts.title: Magenta Film Style
luts.overview: Color matching based on the magenta color cast design of Japanese magazines in the 1980s. The overall color is magenta, bringing a sense of nostalgia to your storytelling.

luts.title: B&W Film Style
luts.overview: The low-contrast dark and bright areas give a rich visual experience like a traditional black-and-white movie.

luts.title: Warming Light
luts.overview: Based on VLOG color grading, it is suitable for daily portrait shooting or indoor shooting. It tends towards warm tones, the color grading is relatively soft, and the overall picture is relatively flat, without having a huge contrast.

luts.title: Spring Portrait
luts.overview: It has low green saturation, giving off a forest green and cool vibe. A certain amount of turquoise is added to the shadows, and a certain amount of magenta is added to the highlights, which works well with skin tones. The contrast in tone is also relatively low, making the picture softer.

luts.title: Vintage Blues
luts.overview: The contrast between light and dark of this LUT is relatively high, making it suited for well-lit environments. This LUT has good stylization whether in cloudy or sunny settings.

luts.title: Cold Green
luts.overview: The color tone of this Portrait Filter has an obvious yellow-green tendency. It has been optimized for human skin tones, so it is also very suitable for portraits.

luts.title: Shadow Story
luts.overview: This was generated by adjusting based on vlog, with bright colors, warm tones and a unique, nostalgic film aesthetic.

luts.title: Powdery Color
luts.overview: Capturing and intensifying the colors of the natural world through saturated and vivid colors, giving a more intense and dramatic effect.

luts.title: Greenish Color
luts.overview: With color reproduction, saturation and skin tones all fine-tuned to excellence, this ensures high light sensitivity while providing rich color gradations.

luts.title: Gray Negative
luts.overview:
This LUT has a light style with low saturation, similar to the style of silver-based film photographs. 
It performs very well on sunny or cloudy days. In sunny scenes, the blue sky will appear in a premium silvery gray. And when shooting on the street on a cloudy day, it will portray a sense of coldness. 
When taking portraits, adjust the exposure to compensate for underexposed faces for better results. 
This LUT is based on standard tints.

luts.title: Greyscale Movie
luts.overview:
This LUT has a light style with low saturation, similar to the style of silver-based film photographs. 
It performs very well on sunny or cloudy days. In sunny scenes, the blue sky will appear in a premium silvery gray. And when shooting on the street on a cloudy day, it will portray a sense of coldness. 
When taking portraits, adjust the exposure to compensate for underexposed faces for better results. 
This LUT is based on standard tints.

luts.title: Summer Warmth
luts.overview:
This LUT has a light style with low saturation, similar to the style of silver-based film photographs. 
It performs very well on sunny or cloudy days. In sunny scenes, the blue sky will appear in a premium silvery gray. And when shooting on the street on a cloudy day, it will portray a sense of coldness. 
When taking portraits, adjust the exposure to compensate for underexposed faces for better results. 
This LUT is based on standard tints.

luts.title: Thick Style
luts.overview:
This LUT has a light style with low saturation, similar to the style of silver-based film photographs. 
It performs very well on sunny or cloudy days. In sunny scenes, the blue sky will appear in a premium silvery gray. And when shooting on the street on a cloudy day, it will portray a sense of coldness. 
When taking portraits, adjust the exposure to compensate for underexposed faces for better results. 
This LUT is based on standard tints.

luts.title: Dramatic BlockBuster-S
luts.overview: This LUT is designed to conveniently enjoy the "teal and orange" look that is frequently used in movies, just by taking the photos. Intended to be applied to photo style "Standard", but can be applied to CINELIKE D2/V2 for more cinematic impression. Optionally, try arbitrarily adjusting shadows, highlights, and contrast to your liking. (This LUT is installed in LUMIX as Sample LUT3.)

luts.title: T-Natural
luts.overview: This LUT is the most natural among all the LUTs I created for this project. I created this with the intention of naturally express the color quality of the LUMIX Series. If you want to make a natural portrait movie, this is the one for you.

luts.title: T-Musician
luts.overview: This gentle LUT is designed for music videos, especially ballad-style songs. I softened the contrast, gave a brighter worldview and added a slightly fainter atmosphere.

luts.title: T-Nostalgy
luts.overview: This LUT reflects an impression of a world reminiscent of Japans' Showa period. By increasing the contrast and adding film grain, I created a truly retro atmosphere.

luts.title: T-Fashionablue
luts.overview: This LUT is perfected with a peculiar color and atmosphere. I boldly blurred the image and added a lot of film grain, then added a flicker to create a cool, retro LUT that is reminiscent of fashion videos.

luts.title: desert
luts.overview: The contrast is slightly increased, and the tonality is reduced in the light areas while slightly lightened in the dark areas. In addition, the highlights are set to have a strong orange tint followed by a blue tint in the shadows. The result is tense, piercing, aggressive, making it suitable for scenes of devastation.

luts.title: sengo
luts.overview: The color temperature is increased and yellowed to give an old-fashioned image quality. Also, it lowers the contrast and reduces the saturation.

luts.title: HollywoodBlue_Day
luts.overview: By reducing the saturation of skin tones while creating an overall shade of blue, this creates a tense atmosphere.

luts.title: HollywoodBlue_Night
luts.overview: To make it suitable for dark scenes, the shadows should not be too dark, and the colors should not destroy the HollywoodBlue vibe.

luts.title: Bloom
luts.overview:
I created a LUT with fresh blue and gentle, deep green to enjoy flowers and natural landscapes. 
Furthermore, adding a blue tint to the shadow area brings out a sense of transparency. 
It is also recommended to adjust contrast and shadows to your liking to create different tones and impressions.

luts.title: Camp-CinemaLUT
luts.overview:
This LUT directly captures the feelings I had when I was camping. 
I tried to make it as natural as possible while still allowing the memories to shine through.

luts.title: Realistic Cinetone
luts.overview: A low-saturation, low-contrast, cinematic base LUT with skin tones tuned towards yellow. It is versatile and can be used as a base to finalize towards your desired look.

luts.title: Realistic Filmtone
luts.overview: This is a base LUT with skin tones tuned closer to yellow, with low saturation and film-like contrast. It is versatile and can be used as a base to finalize towards your desired look.

luts.title: Dramatic BlockBuster
luts.overview: This is a creative LUT with a blockbuster look, balanced with a complementary orange tone with a film-like contrast. It is suitable for music videos and VLOGs, day or night, indoors or outdoors.

luts.title: Nostalgic BleachByPass
luts.overview: This creative LUT has low key, low saturation, high contrast, and a Bleach Bypass look with excellent shadow development and persistence. It is suitable for music videos and vlogs where you want to create a sense of austerity and tension or emphasize the texture of the image.

luts.title: Majestic Noir
luts.overview: This creative LUT has a low key, high saturation, high contrast, and reduced highlights with tight but persistent shadows. It is suitable for music videos and vlogs to express the gritty humidity of a midsummer night and the glossiness of shadows.

luts.title: Romantic Memory
luts.overview: This creative LUT has a slightly high-key color balance that emphasizes split complementary skin tones with a yellowish tinge. It is suitable for music videos, vlogs, etc., to create a clear and transparent look.

luts.title: Silky Chrome
luts.overview: A monochrome LUT with persistent shadows and highlights with rich midtones. The overall soft tone makes it well-suited for flashback scenes, and it is versatile enough to be used as a basis for a monochrome look.

luts.title: Selen Chrome
luts.overview: This is a supple creative monochrome LUT with an impressive cold black color inspired by selenium toning. It is suitable for scenes where you want a monochrome look with richer tones.

luts.title: NEWTRO
luts.overview:
Based on the photography style of People magazine, this LUT was created for recording ordinary everyday life in a somewhat memorable way. It can be used for a wide range of subjects. 
Use it to take pictures of everyday life events as though you were using a disposable camera. 
We recommend that you adjust WB shift, hue, contrast and shadows to your liking for your desired finish.

luts.title: Powdery Snow
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "People" to achieve the skin texture as if you used a photoshop processing app on your smartphone by simply taking the photos. While maintaining the original coloring of LUMIX, the finished image delivers smooth, beautiful skin with a clean, cool feel and a sense of detachment. It is a bit high key, but offers the exposure of your choice.

luts.title: Luminous city
luts.overview: This LUT is designed to capture parts of a city that float in the light attractively. Capturing the good color rendering of the VIVID photo style, the light and dark contrasts are emphasized, and the colors that stand out are suppressed to balance out. This LUT is suitable for street photography for daytime in cities with large differences in brightness and darkness.

luts.title: S-Teal & Orange_1
luts.overview:
This is a versatile LUT that can be used in a variety of situations, based on the teal and orange colors often used in Hollywood movies. 
It works especially well with seaside and snowy landscapes, but can be used for basically any scene. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Teal & Orange_2
luts.overview:
This is a versatile LUT that can be used in a variety of situations, based on the teal and orange colors often used in Hollywood movies. 
It works especially well with seaside and snowy landscapes, but can be used for basically any scene. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Deep Forest_1
luts.overview:
This LUT has a deep green base with a slight bluish tint. 
It works well with scenes with a lot of greenery, and can be especially useful in mountains and forests with lush summer vegetation. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Deep Forest_2
luts.overview:
This LUT has a deep green base with a slight bluish tint. 
It works well with scenes with a lot of greenery, and can be especially useful in mountains and forests with lush summer vegetation. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Golden Hour_1
luts.overview:
This LUT for sunset scenes features an overall orange-tinged color base. 
In particular, this is best applied to soft light just before sunset. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Golden Hour_2
luts.overview:
This LUT for sunset scenes features an overall orange-tinged color base. 
In particular, this is best applied to soft light just before sunset. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Night Time_1
luts.overview:
This LUT can be used for night scenes, with a blue-green base for shadows and yellow/orange base for highlights. 
It is suitable for various night scenes such as city lights, night views, camping, etc. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: S-Night Time_2
luts.overview:
This LUT can be used for night scenes, with a blue-green base for shadows and yellow/orange base for highlights. 
It is suitable for various night scenes such as city lights, night views, camping, etc. 
*There are two contrast settings: low contrast (file name ending with 1) and high contrast (file name ending with 2), so please use according to your preference.

luts.title: Nisebeni
luts.overview: This LUT is based on CINELIKE D2 with its rich tonal gradations, allowing you to easily appreciate landscape photography with greenery. Adding red to the shadows creates a striking contrast. With a completely different atmosphere depending on the brightness, please play around with bold adjustments to the WB shift and hue.

luts.title: Retrostyle709
luts.overview: I created this LUT for indoor table photo based on 709 Like photo style. When applied, the contrast between light and dark is clearly defined, giving the whole image a film-like texture. It gives ordinary table photos a retro, movie-style flavor.

luts.title: Natural LUMIX
luts.overview:
This LUT is designed to make the best use of the LUMIX camera's colors. 
Green and blue tones come out very pleasantly. 
It can be used for portrait movies as well as scenes featuring the skies, forests and trees.

luts.title: Emerald CINEMA
luts.overview:
This LUT creates a cinematic world view while keeping images "clean". 
The strong contrast is effective for scenes where you want to make an impression. 
The color theme featuring blues and greens create a cool and beautiful impression.

luts.title: Warm SKY
luts.overview:
This LUT depicts a world reminiscent of a sunset scene. 
This adds a warm and gentle touch to any scene. 
It is especially effective when used with scenes such as an ocean sunset or evening city.

luts.title: dramaticviolet
luts.overview: A cinematic tone that preserves skin tones. This LUT is suitable for romantic stories and music videos.

luts.title: cinebasemodeA
luts.overview: This LUT is designed to bring out the potential of LUMIX while maintaining the cinematic tones of the camera. This is a standard LUT that can also serve as a base for finalization.

luts.title: Old Cinema-S
luts.overview:
This LUT is based on Standard, reproducing a retro movie-like atmosphere. 
It applies green to the shadows and makes the overall color palette shallower. 
It is highly versatile and can be used in any situation.

luts.title: Teal Flat-S
luts.overview:
This LUT is based on Standard and is adjusted to make Teal & Orange easier to use. 
It adds a bluish tint to shadows and an orange tint to skin tones. From snapshots to portraits, you can easily enjoy the wide range of tastes of Teal & Orange.

luts.title: Dark Night-S
luts.overview:
This LUT is created based on Standard with a slightly darker tone. 
Cold colors for shadows and warm colors for highlights give a relatively calm atmosphere. 
Recommended for those who want to add a touch of class to their nighttime snaps.

luts.title: Smoky Color-S
luts.overview:
This LUT is based on Standard with a strikingly dull color finish. 
By changing how the blue emerges and by removing the warmer colors, it gives a clean and clear image. Recommended for architecture, snapshots and blue sky shots.

luts.title: Clear-S
luts.overview: This LUT is based on Standard and features a blue color that portrays a sense of transparency. When photographing water surfaces or glass, the transparency stands out even more. You can use it in any situation, but since the contrast is high, please adjust the contrast in situations with significant differences in brightness.

luts.title: Backlight-N
luts.overview: This LUT is based on Natural and creates a pale and illusory atmosphere. Warm colors are applied to the entire image, lifting the people's skin while reducing the contrast of the shadows. Best for backlit portrait photography.

luts.title: Filmlike-V2
luts.overview: This LUT is based on Cinelike V2 and reproduces a film-like texture. While the colors are flat, the shadows and highlights create its own style. You can use it freely in any situation.

luts.title: Teal & Orange-D2
luts.overview: This LUT is based on Cinelike D2 and reproduces the basic Teal & Orange as you see in films. This LUT has a wide dynamic range and strong contrast and color.

luts.title: Deep Green-L
luts.overview:
This LUT is based on Landscape and changes yellowish green to deep bluish green. 
This LUT goes well with a scene featuring a lot of green, while it features a safe color palette that can also be easily used for scenes of other colors.

luts.title: Classic Blue-LC
luts.overview: This LUT is based on L. Classic Neo and has a distinctive blue tint that creates a nostalgic atmosphere. It creates impressive images even from everyday scenes.

luts.title: Daily Life
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "Standard" to capture the beautiful colors and light that we find in our daily life in a soothing tone of amber. Take a stroll and use this LUT to take pictures of anything that catches your eye in the city. (This LUT is installed in LUMIX as Sample LUT1.)

luts.title: Film Blue-S
luts.overview: This LUT is based on the photo style "Standard" and produces colors and contrast as if shot with compact film. When using a real-time LUT with grain turned on, the texture of the image can be rendered as if it were shot using film. (This LUT is installed in LUMIX as Sample LUT2.)

luts.title: Film Yellow-S
luts.overview: This is a warm LUT based on the standard, recreating a film-like texture.  We recommend to use with LUMIX S 26mm F8 lens adding grain. It can be used in any situation, so feel free to download and enjoy it.

luts.title: Vlog_709
luts.overview: Converts V-Log video to the common Rec. 709 color space.
